cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the amphoteric COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE@2, supported by glucosides (LAURYL GLUCOSIDE@6, COCO-GLUCOSIDE@12). Counter-signal recorded: two mild anionics (SODIUM LAURYL GLUCOSE CARBOXYLATE@4, SODIUM LAUROYL METHYL ISETHIONATE@7); in an amphoteric-led chassis they do not realistically move the value.

conditioningLevel.rationale: low: cleansing-led architecture with little substantive slip - no silicone, cationic polymer, cationic conditioner, payload lipid or pearlizer; only the weak refatter GLYCERYL OLEATE@10 and GLYCERIN@5. C2 not met.

weightPotential.rationale: low: deposition is absent apart from one weak refatter (GLYCERYL OLEATE@10); no silicone, cationic, lipid, protein or film-former family; the mild amphoteric/glucoside chassis (reset weak) faces almost nothing to remove.
